parsed.name: NI计数器输出设备
parsed.description: 基于 NI-DAQmx 的计数器输出设备接口，主要用于脉冲/时序信号生成与触发控制。
parsed.description_en: An NI-DAQmx counter-output device interface mainly used for pulse/timing signal generation and trigger control.

actions.description: 创建并配置计数器脉冲输出任务。
actions.description_en: Create and configure the counter pulse output task.

actions.description: 启动计数器输出任务并开始输出脉冲。
actions.description_en: Start the counter output task and begin pulse generation.

actions.description: 更新计数器输出任务的参数设置。
actions.description_en: Update the parameter settings of the counter output task.

actions.description: 设置通道1脉冲输出的初始延时。
actions.description_en: Set the initial delay of channel 1 pulse output.

actions.description: 设置通道2脉冲输出的初始延时。
actions.description_en: Set the initial delay of channel 2 pulse output.

actions.description: 设置通道1脉冲的高电平持续时间。
actions.description_en: Set the high-level duration of the channel 1 pulse.

actions.description: 设置通道1脉冲的低电平持续时间。
actions.description_en: Set the low-level duration of the channel 1 pulse.

actions.description: 设置通道2脉冲的高电平持续时间。
actions.description_en: Set the high-level duration of the channel 2 pulse.

actions.description: 设置通道2脉冲输出的周期。
actions.description_en: Set the period of channel 2 pulse output.

actions.description: 设置触发模式或触发使能。
actions.description_en: Set the trigger mode or trigger enable state.

actions.description: 关闭并释放计数器输出任务。
actions.description_en: Close and release the counter output task.
